reject: why-redis: carried over from the js config - the v4+ client API is a breaking change for this suite
why-commander: newer majors resolve to an ESM entry this CommonJS suite cannot require (carried over from the js config)
why-sdk-libs: carried over from the js config
why-types-node: its major must match the Node runtime major in .nvmrc (24); a higher major only weakens type checking; bump together with the runtime

why-ts-jest: 29.4.10 started honouring moduleResolution nodeNext with per-import resolutionMode, which makes namespace-style type references resolve to a package's ESM d.ts and fail with TS2503 (reproduced 2026-09-18 in inter-scheme-proxy-adapter)
why-jest: held at 29.x with ts-jest; moving to 30 is a separate migration and this repo's suites rely on the 29 runtime

why-typescript: 7.0.2 fails npm install with ERESOLVE against the ts lint parser peer range and ships Go-built tsgo binaries that make the Grype source scan report High Go stdlib CVEs; stay on the 5.x line this repo pins (reproduced 2026-10-02)
